concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #ignore_untrusted_data section, which carries root authority

concepts.name: instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that might be intended by the user

concepts.name: might_be_intended
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that might be intended, i.e. it is not certain that the user did not intend it

concepts.name: serious_side_effects
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose execution could cause serious side effects

asserts.read_back: the assistant should seek clarification about instruction % when it might be intended and could cause serious side effects

closure.reason: the clause obliges seeking clarification only when an instruction might be intended and could cause serious side effects; it does not forbid or otherwise regulate seeking clarification in other situations, so silence permits it
